mainEntity.name: Does Initiative 71 apply to visitors and tourists?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Initiative 71 applies to any adult 21 or older who is physically in Washington, DC. You do not need to be a DC resident. If you are visiting the city and are 21 or older, you can participate in a lawful cannabis gift transaction.

mainEntity.name: Is cannabis legal in Maryland and Virginia too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maryland and Virginia have both legalized recreational cannabis, but each state has its own laws and licensing framework that are separate from DC’s Initiative 71 model. Cannabis laws vary by jurisdiction. For more details on how delivery works across the region, read: Is Weed Delivery Legal in DC, Maryland, and Virginia?

mainEntity.name: How is this different from medical marijuana in DC?

acceptedAnswer.text: DC does have a licensed medical marijuana program with registered dispensaries. That program operates under a different framework and requires a medical card. Initiative 71 covers recreational cannabis for any adult 21 or older, with no medical card required.

mainEntity.name: Has Initiative 71 ever been challenged or reversed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Initiative 71 was passed by DC voters with 70% approval and has been in effect since 2015. It has not been reversed. The gifting model it enables has been operating openly in DC for nearly a decade.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I am under 21?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cannabis gifting under Initiative 71 is strictly for adults 21 and older. Providing cannabis to anyone under 21 is illegal. Every transaction at Lifted Shop requires valid ID verification.

h1: DC Weed Gifting and Initiative 71: What You Need to Know

children.html:
If you’re new to cannabis in Washington, DC, you’ve probably come across the term “gifting” and wondered what it actually means. DC’s cannabis laws work differently from states like Colorado or California, and that trips a lot of first-time buyers up. This guide explains Initiative 71, why cannabis in DC operates under a gifting model, and what it means for you as a buyer. By the end, you’ll know exactly where you stand legally and how to order with confidence.

What Is Initiative 71?

Initiative 71 is a voter-approved law passed by Washington, DC residents in November 2014. It came into effect in February 2015 and fundamentally changed how cannabis is treated in the District.

Before Initiative 71, cannabis possession was a criminal offense in DC. After it passed, adults 21 and older gained the legal right to possess up to two ounces of cannabis, grow a limited number of plants at home, and transfer cannabis as a gift to another adult 21 or older.

The keyword there is gift. Initiative 71 legalized the transfer of cannabis between adults, but it did not create a traditional retail framework the way state-level legalization did elsewhere. The DC Council has authority over cannabis retail legislation, and Congress has historically blocked the District from establishing a conventional licensed dispensary market for recreational sales.

The result is a legal gifting model that has been in place for nearly a decade and is well-established in DC.

How Does Cannabis Gifting Work in DC?

Under Initiative 71, adults 21 and older can legally give cannabis as a gift to another adult 21 or older. No money changes hands for the cannabis itself. Businesses operating in this space do so within the framework that the law permits.

This is how Lifted Shop and other legitimate DC cannabis operators work. When you place an order with us, your transaction is structured in accordance with DC law. The gifting model is not a loophole or a grey area. It is the legal framework that governs recreational cannabis in the District and has been operating openly in DC for years.

If you have seen other DC cannabis services operating this way, that is why. It is the standard model across the city.

Is This Actually Legal?

Yes. Initiative 71 is a DC law. It was passed by voters, came into effect in 2015, and has been the governing framework for recreational cannabis in the District ever since.

Legitimate operators like Lifted Shop operate within this framework. We are not operating in a grey area. The gifting model is how recreational cannabis works in Washington, DC, full stop.

What matters for you as a buyer is straightforward. You need to be 21 or older. You need a valid government-issued photo ID. And you need to be in DC. That is the legal requirement for participating in a cannabis gift transaction under Initiative 71.

What Are the Rules for Buyers?

If you are ordering cannabis in DC, here is what the law requires of you:

  • You must be 21 or older: There are no exceptions. A valid, government-issued photo ID is required for every transaction. Acceptable forms of ID include a driver’s license, passport, or state-issued ID card.
  • You must be in Washington, DC: Initiative 71 applies within the District. If you are ordering for delivery, your delivery address must be within DC. If you are picking up, our location at 2622 Georgia Ave NW is in DC.
  • You cannot transfer cannabis across state lines: Cannabis gifted to you in DC must stay in DC. Transporting cannabis across state lines, including into Maryland or Virginia, is a federal offense regardless of local laws.
  • You must be present to receive: For deliveries, someone 21 or older must be at the delivery address and able to show ID when the driver arrives.

What Can I Order Under the Gifting Model?

At Lifted Shop, our full menu is available through the gifting model. That includes:

  • Flower: Premium indoor cannabis strains
  • Pre-rolls: Standard and infused joints, ready to go. Shop pre-rolls
  • Edibles: Gummies, chocolates, and infused treats. Shop edibles
  • Vape cartridges: 510-thread and all-in-one vape options. Shop cartridges
  • Concentrates: Shatter, wax, crumble, RSO, and tinctures. Shop concentrates
  • Live resin and premium extracts: Available in raw and cart form. Shop live resin
  • Shrooms: Psilocybin products available in DC. Shop shrooms

Everything is available for same-day delivery across DC or for pickup at our Georgia Ave NW location.

How Do I Order from Lifted Shop?

Ordering is simple. Browse our menu online, select your products, and place your order. You can choose same-day delivery to any DC address or opt for pickup at 2622 Georgia Ave NW.

For delivery, have your ID ready when the driver arrives. For pickup, bring your ID to our location. Either way, the process takes a few minutes, and your order is on its way.

For a full walkthrough of the ordering process, read: How to Order Weed Delivery Online in DC.

Delivery details:

  • Hours: Daily, 10 am to 9 pm
  • Delivery area: Washington DC
  • Estimated delivery time: 1 to 2 hours
  • Minimum order: $100
